leds.evidence: Three LEDs (green, yellow, red) are visible on the right side of the breadboard.

found: Resistor connected to the green LED
Resistor connected to the yellow LED
Resistor connected to the red LED
resistor_count.evidence: Three resistors are visible, each connected in series with one of the three LEDs.

led_polarity.evidence: The LEDs are oriented with their longer legs (anodes) connected to the signal wires coming from the Arduino, which is the standard correct orientation.

button.evidence: A large round blue button is clearly visible on the breadboard.

button_across.evidence: The button is placed across the central channel of the breadboard, with two pins on one side and two on the other.

buzzer.evidence: A black circular buzzer is visible on the left side of the breadboard.

gnd_other_end.evidence: The black wire from the GND pin on the Arduino is connected to the negative power rail on the breadboard.
